faqs.answer:
🤖 I'm MicroLab's AI-powered support assistant. I can help you with:

🔹 **Tests** — available tests, fasting, pricing, report timings
🔹 **Bookings** — how to book, cancel, or reschedule
🔹 **Branches** — locations, hours, contact numbers
🔹 **Home Collection** — how it works, slot info
🔹 **Reports** — turnaround times, how to download

Try asking: 'Do I need to fast?', 'Where is T Nagar branch?', or 'How long for my report?'

🕐 **MicroLab Branch Hours:**

• **T Nagar & Anna Nagar** — Mon–Sat: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM · Sun: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM
• **Adyar** — Mon–Sat: 7:30 AM – 7:30 PM · Sun: 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Home collection slots are available from 6:00 AM – 11:00 AM.

🍽️ **Fasting requirements:**

• **Fasting required (8–12 hrs):** HbA1c, Fasting Blood Glucose, Lipid Profile, Triglycerides
• **No fasting needed:** CBC, Thyroid Profile, Vitamin D, Urine Routine, COVID tests

Each test card in the app shows whether fasting is required. When in doubt, check the test details before booking.

⏱️ **Typical report turnaround times:**

• CBC, Blood Sugar, Urine Routine — 24 hrs
• Thyroid Profile (T3/T4/TSH) — 24 hrs
• HbA1c — 48 hrs
• Lipid Profile — 24 hrs
• Vitamins (D, B12) & Hormones — 48–72 hrs
• Culture tests — 3–5 days

You'll receive an SMS and in-app notification once your report is ready.

🏠 **Home Collection:**
1. Book & choose a time slot (6 AM – 11 AM)
2. Our trained phlebotomist arrives at your door
3. Sample collected & sent to the lab
4. Report shared in the app within the promised time

🏥 **Lab Visit:**
1. Walk in or book a slot in advance
2. Collect a token at the reception
3. Sample collected in our phlebotomy room
4. Download your report from the app

❌ **To cancel a booking:**

1. Go to the **Bookings** tab in the app
2. Open the booking you want to cancel
3. Tap **Cancel Booking**

Refunds for online payments are processed within **5–7 business days** back to your original payment method.

🔄 **To reschedule a booking:**

Cancel the existing booking and create a new one with your preferred slot. For urgent reschedules, call **1800-XXX-XXXX** and we'll assist you directly.

💳 **Payment issue?**

If payment was deducted but your booking wasn't confirmed, email us at **support@microlab.in** with:
• Your mobile number
• Payment screenshot
• Approximate time of transaction

We'll resolve it within **24 hours**.

📞 **Contact MicroLab Support:**

• **Toll-Free:** 1800-XXX-XXXX
• **Email:** support@microlab.in
• **Hours:** Mon–Sat, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM

For branch-specific queries, call the branch directly.
💳 We accept **Credit/Debit cards, UPI, Net Banking**, and **Pay Later** (pay at the lab) for eligible bookings. Payments are processed securely via Razorpay.

🏥 **MicroLab Diagnostics** is a trusted diagnostic lab in Chennai offering accurate, affordable, and timely medical tests. We specialise in home blood sample collection, making it easy for patients to get tested from the comfort of their homes.

We have 3 branches across Chennai — T Nagar, Adyar, and Anna Nagar.

📄 **To access your report:**

1. Open the MicroLab app
2. Go to the **Reports** tab
3. Select the booking
4. Tap **Download PDF** or **Share**

You'll also receive an SMS notification when your report is ready.
